items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 6 at 2:34AM EDT until October 7 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...In New Jersey, Sussex County. In Pennsylvania, Carbon and
Monroe Counties.

* WHEN...From 11 PM this evening to 9 AM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
items.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 6 at 1:23AM EDT until October 6 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Caribou ME
items.areaDesc: Northwest Aroostook; Northeast Aroostook; Northern Somerset; Northern Piscataquis; Northern Penobscot; Southeast Aroostook; Central Piscataquis
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Central Piscataquis, Northern Penobscot, Southeast
Aroostook, Northeast Aroostook, Northwest Aroostook, Northern
Somerset, and Northern Piscataquis Counties.

* WHEN...From 8 AM this morning to 5 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
Strong winds will also create wind chills as low as 10 to 20
degrees on mountain tops.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
